policy: References establish appearance and identity, not surveyed fitting dimensions. No reference photograph, raster texture, audio or video is distributed. Original source courses, source entrance identities and measured step counts are retained.

sources.title: Retained OpenStreetMap Berlin snapshot
sources.use: 117 selected records: source tram tags and coordinates, three source stair ways and their three top entrance nodes; no inferred elevator or access point becomes a stair. All 107 new rail courses equal their retained core catenary source courses. Four bridge courses keep the previous elevation owner.
